changelog:
Version 7.8.95

Improved

  • A cached page that has expired is now refreshed in the background right after it is delivered, so the next visitor no longer waits for a full page build.
  • Full and Auto: on desktop, the main menu keeps a single row while its fonts load.
  • Lab and Maximum: the matched stand-in fonts are registered in a way that a late font stylesheet can no longer reload them, reducing text movement while the page loads.
